messages:
Sara (support): FYI escalating an odd one from a customer — intermittent 400s from /v1/embeddings when they send mixed-length requests. Error text: "embedding dimension mismatch". Happens ~1-3% of calls.
Alex Chen: Can you paste a repro request & their SDK version? Any correlation with model param?
Sara (support): Customer using our hosted embeddings with model 'redwood-embed-1536'. SDK reported v1.2.3. They sent batches of inputs (sometimes 1 string, sometimes array of strings). Sample payload they sent:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1536",
  "input": ["short text", "a much longer paragraph...", "mid length"]
}
```
Sara (support): Error log from our gateway: `400 Bad Request - embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536 got 1537`
Meera Rao: Hmm. That suggests a stray padding byte or an extra value in the final vector tensor. Do we have any recent kernel/quantization branch that might append metadata to vectors?
Jordan P: Also, dynamic batching code recently changed padding loop to append a sentinel 0.0 for empty sequences — could that be miscounting dimension size for string inputs that become empty after tokenization? Tagging @Meera for runtime check.
Alex Chen: Customer says it only happens when one of the strings is exactly "" (empty) or when client sends a single-item request immediately followed by a 3-item request. Sounds like pooling/kv-cache boundary leakage.
Meera Rao: Repro locally after a few runs. I can trigger it by alternating single-item and multi-item calls with small inter-arrival. Repro script attached:
```bash
# repro loop
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1536","input":"hello"}' &
  sleep 0.02
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1536","input":["","long text that tokenizes to >1 segment","mid"]}'
  sleep 0.05
done
```
Meera Rao: Stacktrace shows padding code sets shape = [batch, seqlen, dim]; an off-by-one when seqlen==0 sets dim+1 in a temp buffer before copy.
ml-runtime-bot: New regression build 2026.03.08-r13 deployed to canary at 2475003000.
Jordan P: Good catch. Do we have a safe mitigation to push to prod asap? Maybe validate tokenized lengths and reject empty strings at the API gateway level instead of letting runtime pad.
Alex Chen: For customer-facing fix: 1) return 400 with clearer message if empty input present, 2) roll out a hotfix to padding routine to avoid the off-by-one. Can support issue a temporary workaround?
Sara (support): I'll ask customer to filter out empty strings on their side and stop rapid alternating if possible. Sending repro to their SRE for short-term.
Meera Rao: I'll prepare a minimal patch to padding logic and a unit test for the empty-seq case. Targeting canary hotfix in next 2 hours.
Jordan P: Also add a defensive check in the batching layer: before concatenation, assert per-item vector dim == model_dim or else drop batch and fallback to single-item sync path.
Alex Chen: Noted. Owner: Meera for runtime fix, Jordan for batching guard, Sara to coordinate with customer and update ticket.
Sara (support): Customer ok with workaround for now but wants ETA. I'll reply: ETA hotfix canary in ~2h, prod roll once canary stable (~4-6h).
ops-bot: deploy 2026.03.08-hotfix-embed-padding started at 2475003550
Meera Rao: Canary looks clean after patch. Running the repro script 10k iterations without failures.
Sara (support): Thanks team — will follow up with customer and close after prod rollout.
